title: Parking License Addendum — Cancellation Notice, Move-Out and Transfer
content:
A resident cancels a Parking License by signing a cancellation notice.

## Terms of cancellation and end of license

**1. Notice period.** The end date must be at least the product's notice-to-cancel figure in calendar days after the notice date, and a Surface Unreserved Permit may end on any date.

**2. Licenses that run with the lease.** A license whose term runs with the lease cannot be cancelled on its own before the lease term ends except on the same terms.

**3. Withdrawing a notice.** A notice may be withdrawn until its end date while the space has not been offered to the waitlist.

**4. Move-out.** Every license ends on the lease's move-out date without notice or early cancellation fee.

**5. In-community transfer.** A license carries over to the new apartment home on an in-community transfer when the product carries over on such a transfer.

**6. Final account.** The balance left on a terminated license is carried into the final account statement.

## Boundary of the notice period

Counting in calendar days from the notice date:

| End date chosen | Against the product's notice figure | Meets the notice period |
|---|---|---|
| exactly the notice figure in calendar days after the notice date | equal | yes ("at least" includes the boundary day) |
| one calendar day earlier | short by one day | no |
| any date, on a Surface Unreserved Permit | not applicable | yes |

## Retired clause

*Retired:* "When the end date falls before the start date plus the product's minimum commitment months, an early cancellation fee of the product's early cancellation fee months times the monthly fee is billed with the notice." This clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the early cancellation fee.

superseded_clauses: When the end date falls before start_date plus min_commitment_months, an early_cancellation_fee of early_cancellation_fee_months times the monthly fee is billed with the notice.
